thesis: Pre-open news pack for 2026-06-05 is thin and diffuse, featuring mostly stale previous-day items, routine political transaction filings, lifestyle articles, and speculative commentary (such as Masayoshi Son calling AI 50x bigger than dot-com and Greg Abel / GOOGL editorial opinion) alongside macro notes on memory-chip supply and Fed rate expectations. None of these present a clear, actionable catalyst or fundamental shift warranting a trade in our universe. As a balanced agent with core equity (VTI), fixed income ballast (BND), and growth/tech exposure (NVDA, XLK), the existing 4-position allocation remains well within our risk parameters (max 6 positions, single names well under the 35% cap). Preserving our $35.00 cash reserve (~32% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% cash floor) avoids forced turnover on low-conviction headlines.
